post.summary: Submit Flux Dev Image to Image Task

input.prompt: Reimagine this same reading room as a warm and inviting evening interior. Retain the principal perspective, the large window on the left, the central rectangular table and chairs, and the low shelves on the right. Replace the cold concrete wall finish with warm light-oak paneling and the floor with natural oak planks; give the chairs comfortable muted rust-colored upholstery. Add subtle warm reading light above the table and a gentle glow along the shelves. Through the existing window, show the soft blue light of dusk. Realistic architectural photography with convincing wood grain, fabric texture and balanced warm interior light against cool outdoor light. The room remains simple, unoccupied and clearly related to the original layout. No text, logos, commercial styling or watermark.

A bold Fauvist oil painting on rough linen canvas of a golden dog running on a beach. PAINTING, not a photograph. Broad angular strokes of ochre, terracotta and cream construct the complete dog in SIDE PROFILE facing RIGHT, tail to the LEFT; keep the overall dog silhouette and beach subject from the reference. Four natural legs in a running stride. The entire animal fits comfortably in the lower half of the portrait canvas. Build the sea and sky from large flat patches of muted teal, pale blue and warm grey. Scraped palette-knife impasto, thick raised paint ridges, broken color and visible bristle marks across every part of the composition, simplified shapes, expressive brushwork, deliberately painterly edges. An unframed full-bleed fine-art painting with no decorative border, no lettering, no signature, no watermark.

Use the supplied photograph as the fixed composition for a seasonal weather variation. Show the SAME entire dark-green step-through bicycle from the SAME SIDE VIEW: front wheel and wicker front basket on the LEFT, rear wheel and saddle on the RIGHT, two wheels side by side and both fully visible. Keep the pale plaster wall directly behind the bicycle, the wooden gate on the far LEFT and the leafy tree above the wall on the RIGHT. Preserve the original wide camera position, lens perspective, bicycle position and scale. Change only the weather, ground moisture and foliage: soft overcast autumn daylight, fine rain, wet stone paving with small puddles, scattered russet leaves, and amber foliage on the existing tree. Realistic gentle reflections, naturally aged materials and subtle rain streaks. A quiet residential courtyard, not an alley. Do not rotate the bicycle or move the camera. No rear view, no people, no extra bicycles, no text, no logos, no watermark.

image_urls.description: Source image URL for image-to-image editing. Provide one image.

size.description: Text-to-image output canvas. Presets: 1:1 (512×512), 1:1 HD (1024×1024), 4:3 (1024×768), 3:4 (768×1024), 16:9 (1024×576), 9:16 (576×1024). Custom WIDTHxHEIGHT dimensions are positive integers. Image-to-image output is guided by the source image.
